added.title: Principal AI/ML Engineer – Data Analytics & AI
added.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Do you want to engineer the platforms that take agentic AI from prototype to production?

Lilly USA is scaling AI from prototype to everyday business capability, from how we bring medicines to market to how we help patients access and afford them. The Lilly USA Technology at Lilly Data Analytics & AI team is seeking a Principal AI/ML Engineer to build the agentic AI and machine learning platforms that power this work. You will turn prototypes into reliable, scalable, well-governed production systems. You will also build the data pipelines, partner integrations, and ML engineering foundations that teams reuse across business use cases.

What You'll Be Doing

As a Principal AI/ML Engineer, you will design and build the engineering backbone for the AI and ML systems that serve business teams across Lilly USA: the orchestration frameworks, end-to-end data and model pipelines, serving infrastructure, and the evaluation and monitoring that keep them reliable in production. You will work at the intersection of enterprise data, business operations, field and customer-facing teams, and third-party partner integrations. You will partner closely with data scientists to productionize models and agentic workflows. You will also work with technical product managers, business and field teams, and Technology at Lilly colleagues to bring those solutions into real applications in a secure and auditable way. You will reuse infrastructure and patterns so that each new business use case is faster and cheaper to ship.

Examples of the kinds of problems you might work on:

Agentic AI workflows that help field and commercial teams prepare for engagements, surface insights, and act faster, including multi-agent systems that reason over complex data and recommend the best next step.
Predictive and machine-learning models that inform decisions about market access, customer outreach, resource allocation, and revenue protection, from anomaly detection to next-best-action.
LLM-powered solutions that make large volumes of unstructured information usable, using techniques like retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to ground answers in trusted, cited sources.
Secure, analytics-ready data pipelines that bring partner and vendor data into our platforms at scale, with the data quality, governance, and auditability a regulated environment demands.
Shared, reusable AI tooling for deployment, evaluation, and monitoring that multiple teams build on instead of rebuilding, so each new solution ships faster and more reliably than the last.

How You'll Succeed

Build and operationalize agentic AI platforms, including agent-to-agent orchestration frameworks, multi-agent workflow engines, tool and API integration layers, and secure connectivity between agents, enterprise systems, and external partner platforms.
Build and integrate data pipelines, bringing data from enterprise systems, external vendors, and third-party partners into secure, analytics-ready platforms.
Deliver AI capabilities for business use cases, such as reporting, predictive analytics, process and decision optimization, and decision support for field and commercial teams.
Engineer robust, end-to-end AI/ML pipelines, covering data capture, feature engineering, training, fine-tuning, inference, and feedback, at production scale and reliability.
Stand up ML engineering foundations, including model and prompt versioning, registries, experiment tracking, continuous integration and delivery for models, and automated evaluation and rollback within each pipeline.
Apply production-grade deployment techniques, including scalable model serving, containerization, inference optimization, and deployment of small and specialized models hosted in-house, with attention to latency, cost, scalability, and data residency.
Build observability and monitoring for AI systems, including tracing of agentic workflows, cost and latency tracking, drift detection, and integration of AI evaluation into production monitoring.
Implement governance and data-protection controls, including privacy and regulatory compliance (e.g., HIPAA where applicable), PHI and PII handling, de-identification, and auditability consistent with a regulated environment.
Design reusable, horizontal engineering capabilities and shared infrastructure that multiple teams and use cases can build on, rather than one-off deployments.
Partner with data scientists to productionize prototypes and harden them for scale, reliability, and maintainability, and work with business users to drive adoption.
Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders and stay current with emerging agentic and ML engineering tooling.
Manage and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously.

What You Should Bring

Foundational knowledge in communication, leadership, teamwork, problem solving, solution and blueprint definition, business acumen, architectural processes (e.g., blueprinting, reference architecture, governance), technical standards, project delivery, and the industry.

Business Analysis And Technical Leadership, Including

Engaging with the business and proactively seeking opportunities to deliver business value.
Understanding business requirements and effectively translating business needs and processes into technical terms, and vice versa.
Eliciting and defining requirements.
Ensuring appropriate business roles are engaged in solution execution.
Participating in design reviews to ensure traceability of requirements.
Networking with appropriate Technology at Lilly colleagues to determine solutions that meet business partners' needs.
Seeking opportunities to reuse existing processes and services to streamline support and implementation of key systems.
Staying abreast of tools and technologies to influence Technology at Lilly strategy so that it provides the best usage opportunities for the business.

Basic Qualifications

Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative or technical field, with at least 1 year of professional experience implementing technical systems
OR Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative or technical field, with at least 3 years of professional experience implementing technical systems
Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, J-1, H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, or L-1.

Preferred Qualifications

Strong proficiency in Python and sound software-engineering practices, including version control, testing, and code review.
Experience taking ML or data solutions from idea through production deployment, including working with business users to get them adopted.
End-to-end ML engineering: experience with model and prompt versioning, registries, experiment tracking, continuous integration and delivery for models, automated evaluation in pipelines, and observability for AI systems.
Production deployment: experience with scalable model serving, containerization, inference optimization, and deployment and serving of large models and small, specialized models, plus fine-tuning and distillation pipelines.
Agentic platforms: experience engineering agent-to-agent orchestration and multi-agent workflow frameworks with modern tooling (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent), including tool and API integration and secure agent connectivity.
Data engineering: experience building scalable data pipelines, SQL and NoSQL data stores, distributed processing, vector databases, and retrieval systems.
Cloud and tooling: experience with AWS or Azure, Databricks, containers, Git, and CI/CD automation.
Governance: experience with secure, auditable systems, PHI and PII handling, and data-residency constraints.
Partner integrations: experience integrating data and services from external partners, such as vendors, data providers, or health platforms, through APIs and secure data exchange.
Domain: familiarity with the U.S. healthcare and pharma landscape (e.g., payers, providers, PBMs, patient access), or a demonstrated ability to ramp quickly in a complex, regulated domain. Experience in healthcare or pharma is a plus.
Demonstrated ability to deliver reliable systems in complex data domains and to communicate with a geographically dispersed group of business and technical colleagues.

About The Organization

Technology at Lilly builds and maintains capabilities with cutting-edge technologies, as the most prominent tech companies do. Technology at Lilly is different because we use technology to advance our purpose: creating medicines that make life better for people around the world. Examples include data-driven drug discovery, connected clinical trials, and AI that helps patients access and afford their medicines. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver innovative solutions in every area of our business.

The Lilly USA Technology at Lilly team is at the forefront of leveraging data and technology to launch new medicines to market, raise awareness, and help appropriate patients get access to medication. We partner closely with Lilly's market access organization, which works with payers, employers, and government customers to improve affordability and broaden access. With a deep technical and business understanding, working across all therapeutic areas and disease states, we design and implement digital solutions to power our business. We use real-world evidence and health outcomes data to reduce friction across the patient journey, create best-in-class customer engagements, improve patient outcomes, and deliver business results.

0–10%

If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.

added.description:
Company Overview

Abiologics, Inc. is a privately held, early-stage biotechnology company on a mission to make biology better through an innovative therapeutic modality. We are pioneering the development of SynteinsTM, a transformational class of macromolecular medicines unlocked by novel synthetic and computational technologies. Abiologics is actively seeking exceptional molecular scientists who are passionate about driving therapeutic modality innovation in biotechnology.

Abiologics was founded in Flagship Pioneering’s venture creation engine, where companies such as Moderna Therapeutics (NASDAQ: MRNA) and Generate Biomedicines were conceived and created. Since Flagship’s founding in 2000, the firm has originated and fostered the development of more than 100 scientific ventures resulting in more than 500 issued patents and more than 50 clinical trials for novel therapeutic agents.

About The Role

We are hiring a Machine Learning Scientist to train, validate and ship the predictive models that power our molecular design platform. You will build models that score chemical molecules for developability (ADMET), potency, synthesizability and 3D structure, working alongside chemists, biologists and platform engineers.

In your first year, success means two or three models in production use by project teams, each with documented benchmarks, calibrated uncertainty and a clear applicability domain.

What You Will Do

Train and maintain ML models for ADMET and developability endpoints such as solubility, permeability, metabolic stability, toxicity and aggregation risk.
Build potency and binding models (QSAR, ligand- and structure-based) to rank and prioritize molecules against targets.
Develop synthesizability models: synthetic accessibility scoring, reaction-outcome prediction and retrosynthesis-informed filters.
Apply and fine-tune structure-aware models (GNNs, equivariant networks, protein-ligand structure and docking-informed ML).
Curate and clean assay data, define scaffold- or time-split benchmarks, and quantify uncertainty and applicability domain.
Package models for the platform with engineers: versioned, reproducible and monitored for drift.
Present results and limits of each model to chemists and project teams, and incorporate their feedback into retraining.

What You Bring

PhD in computational chemistry, cheminformatics, machine learning or a related field, or an MS plus equivalent industry experience (about 3-6 years of hands-on modeling).
Demonstrated experience training and validating ML models on chemical or molecular data, in industry or academia, with shipped or published results.
Direct experience with at least two of: ADMET/developability, potency/binding, synthesizability/retrosynthesis, protein or ligand structure.
Fluency with molecular representations (fingerprints, descriptors, graphs, 3D) and tools such as RDKit.
Strong Python and a deep learning framework (PyTorch preferred); experience with GNNs or transformers on molecules.
Rigorous evaluation habits: scaffold or temporal splits, baselines, noisy-label handling and uncertainty estimation.
Clear communication with chemists and biologists.

Nice To Have

Publications, open-source contributions or competition results in molecular ML.
Experience with generative design, active learning or Bayesian optimization loops.
Experience with large-scale training, MLOps and model serving.
Familiarity with docking, free-energy methods or protein structure prediction tools.
Experience working with biologics or non-small-molecule modalities.

More About Flagship Pioneering

Flagship Pioneering is a biotechnology company that invents and builds platform companies, each with the potential for multiple products that transform human health or sustainability. Since its launch in 2000, Flagship has originated and fostered more than 100 scientific ventures, resulting in more than $90 billion in aggregate value. Many of the companies Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture. Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies, and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Learn more about Flagship at www.flagshippioneering.com.

Flagship Pioneering and our ecosystem companies are committed to equal employment opportunity
regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

At Flagship, we recognize there is no perfect candidate. If you have some of the experience listed above but not all, please apply anyway. Experience comes in many forms, skills are transferable, and passion goes a long way. We are dedicated to building diverse and inclusive teams and look forward to learning more about your unique background.

added.title: Senior Data Scientist
added.description:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary

ExtraHop is at the forefront of cybersecurity innovation, delivering Network Detection and Response (NDR) solutions that help organizations detect, investigate, and respond to cyber threats in real time.

Join ExtraHop as a Senior Data Scientist and help advance the machine learning and artificial intelligence capabilities that power our products. You will analyze large-scale network telemetry, develop and evaluate methods for identifying malicious behavior, and improve the accuracy and efficacy of ExtraHop’s threat detection capabilities.

This is an applied data science role for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous, high-impact problems using statistical analysis, experimentation, and machine learning. You will work closely with other data scientists, threat researchers, and software engineers to translate research into reliable product capabilities, and play a key role in contributing to the improvement of the RevealX platform.

Key Responsibilities

Analyze large-scale network telemetry to identify behavioral patterns, anomalies, and signals associated with malicious activity.
Design, develop, and refine machine learning and AI-based methods that support ExtraHop’s products.
Develop evaluation methods appropriate for cybersecurity data, including highly imbalanced datasets, incomplete labels, rare events, and changing attacker and network behavior.
Conduct exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, model development, and error analysis using complex, high-volume datasets.
Research emerging machine learning and AI techniques, relevant cybersecurity developments, and assess their applicability to ExtraHop’s products.
Establish metrics and monitoring strategies for measuring model and detector performance over time.
Communicate findings, limitations, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to technical stakeholders and product leaders.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other data scientists through code reviews, design discussions, technical strategy, and contributions to the team’s analytical and engineering standards.
Document methodologies, experiments, model behavior, and evaluation results.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested production-quality code.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
7+ years of professional experience in data science, including developing and evaluating machine learning models for real-world use cases, defining meaningful success metrics, and conducting rigorous offline and online evaluations.
Strong foundation in statistics, experimental design, machine learning, and model evaluation.
Experience working with incomplete, noisy, or highly imbalanced data; performing detailed error analysis; and identifying the causes of false positives and false negatives.
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, experience with common data science and machine learning libraries, and the ability to write maintainable, tested, and reviewable code.
Experience collaborating with software engineers to integrate data science methods into production systems.
Strong problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and a track record of independently owning complex technical work.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings, uncertainty, and tradeoffs to varied audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative discipline.
Experience applying data science or machine learning to cybersecurity, fraud detection, abuse detection, anomaly detection, or another adversarial domain.
Familiarity with Network Detection and Response, network protocols, threat detection, or incident investigation.
Experience with time-series analysis, anomaly detection, actuarial modeling, clustering, graph analytics, or unsupervised and semi-supervised learning.
Experience evaluating models in domains where positive examples are rare, labels are incomplete, and the underlying behavior changes over time.
Experience with generative AI, large language models, agentic systems, or other emerging AI techniques.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP.

added.title: Physical AI Engineer
added.description:
Build the Future of Robotics with Physical AI

We are building real-world Physical AI systems where models interact with physical machines. This role is for a robotics engineer with a strong reinforcement learning (RL) mindset, someone who wants to train, evaluate, and deploy intelligent behaviors that emerge through interaction, not just perception, by building the virtual environments, generating the data that trains our models, and developing the policies that eventually run on real hardware.

Day to day, you will design simulation environments, produce large volumes of labeled synthetic data, train and evaluate learned policies, and work with engineers across robotics, controls, and perception to close the sim-to-real gap. You will work hands-on with NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim, physics-based simulation, and foundation models. This is a builder role: fast iteration, scalable training, and direct transfer from simulation to physical robots.

What You'll Do

Build and maintain high-fidelity, physics-accurate simulation environments in NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim for training, testing, and validating robotic systems.
Generate synthetic datasets at scale, including sensor and camera simulation, domain randomization, procedural scene variation, and automated annotation such as segmentation, depth, bounding boxes, and pose. You own dataset quality, versioning, and delivery.
Design and run reinforcement learning and imitation learning pipelines using simulation-generated and synthetic data.
Train and tune policies for control, planning, navigation, and manipulation, with emphasis on robustness and sim-to-real performance.
Define task curricula, reward functions, and evaluation benchmarks so policy performance is measured before it reaches hardware.
Model sensors, actuators, and contact behavior, and debug simulation instability, non-physical behavior, and determinism issues.
Drive simulation-to-real transfer through domain randomization, system identification, and validation on physical systems.
Build reusable tooling, APIs, and documentation so the broader team can stand up new environments and tasks without deep simulation expertise.
Integrate foundation models to support reasoning, task decomposition, and human-in-the-loop learning.

Requirements

5+ years in robotics, reinforcement learning, simulation, or applied machine learning. Degree in Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.
Hands-on experience training robotic agents in simulation, on physical systems, or both.
Strong background in reinforcement learning, imitation learning, or learning-based control, including domain randomization and curriculum learning.
Proven experience building simulation environments in NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim, or Isaac Lab, or comparable GPU-accelerated simulation platforms.
Direct experience generating synthetic data for model training, including sensor simulation, annotation pipelines, and large-scale dataset generation.
Working knowledge of OpenUSD as a robotics engineer, including asset conversion into a simulation pipeline from formats such as URDF or MJCF.
Production experience with at least one RL library: RSL-RL, RL-Games, skrl, or Stable-Baselines3.
Strong Python and the deep learning stack, such as PyTorch or JAX, with the ability to build and scale training pipelines beyond a single workstation.
Experience applying or integrating foundation models into robotics or decision-making workflows.
Builder mindset with a track record of moving learning systems from experiment to deployment.

Nice to Have

PhysX schemas and physics tuning.
MuJoCo Playground, NVIDIA Warp, or Newton.
Omniverse Replicator or comparable synthetic data generation frameworks.
World foundation models used for data augmentation and photoreal domain transfer.
Vision language action models or multimodal policies.
ROS 2 or comparable robotics middleware, real-time systems, or physics engines.
Model-free or model-based RL at scale, including distributed or cloud-scale training orchestration.
Training perception models such as detection, segmentation, or pose estimation on synthetic data.
C++ alongside Python for real-time robotics systems.
Experience operationalizing learned policies on physical robots in production environments.

Work Environment

Remote or hybrid, US-based, with periodic time onsite at our robotics facility.
Occasional domestic and global travel.
Flexible working hours aligned to experimentation and training cycles.
This description is optimized to attract senior, hands‑on AI robotics engineers with strong reinforcement learning and simulation expertise.

You will be a power user of agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, and you will turn that fluency into shared skills, plugins, and standards that make every engineer and agent on the team faster and more reliable. You will define the testing and evaluation practices that keep Gen AI applications and agents trustworthy in production, then prove those practices on enterprise-wide initiatives by working with business stakeholders, data engineers, data scientists, platform and security teams, and product managers.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

AI-Enabled Engineering & Standards

Be a daily, advanced user of agentic coding tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and similar) and set enterprise practices for them: context engineering, project instruction files (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md), plan-then-implement workflows, subagents, parallel sessions, hooks, and permission and sandbox settings.
Design, build, and maintain skills, plugins, slash commands, subagents, hooks, and MCP servers that encode our standards and workflows (for example scaffolding, ticket creation, PR review, test and eval generation), and distribute them to engineers through a versioned, shared plugin catalog.
Publish engineering standards as living, agent-readable instructions that both people and coding agents follow, and keep them short, tested, and current as tools and models change.
Define an AI-assisted delivery lifecycle: spec-driven development, small reviewable changes, automated AI-assisted code review, and clear human accountability for everything that ships, with guardrails for security, secrets, data classification, and IP.
Establish reference architectures, project templates, and reusable accelerators that are agent-ready, so teams across brands and functions start from a secure, tested, production-ready baseline.
Measure the impact of AI-assisted engineering (cycle time, rework, defect rates, token cost) and use the evidence to refine tools, prompts, and practices.
Partner with the GenAI CoE to publish standards, run design reviews, and retire patterns that no longer serve the enterprise.

Testing & Quality Engineering

Set the testing strategy for Gen AI systems, including unit, integration, contract, end-to-end, regression, load, and security testing for APIs, retrieval pipelines, agents, and tool integrations.
Use coding agents to generate and maintain tests at scale, with human-reviewed intent and checks such as mutation testing to confirm the tests actually catch defects.
Build test harnesses that handle non-deterministic behavior, including mocked model and tool responses, recorded fixtures, and deterministic seams around LLM calls.
Build verification loops that let agents check their own work (tests, type checks, linters, and evals) before a human reviews it.
Enforce automated quality gates in CI/CD (tests, static analysis, dependency and secret scanning, AI-assisted review, and evaluation checks) so no agent or application ships without passing them.
Lead blameless post-incident reviews and feed findings back into standards, skills, and tests.

Evaluation Frameworks

Design and own the enterprise evaluation framework for LLM applications and agents: golden datasets, rubric- and model-graded evals, human review workflows, and task-completion, groundedness, hallucination, safety, latency, and cost metrics.
Create evaluation approaches specific to RAG (retrieval precision and recall, citation accuracy), tool-using agents (tool selection, argument correctness, trajectory quality), and multi-agent workflows.
Integrate evals into CI/CD as release gates and into production as continuous monitoring, with clear thresholds, dashboards, and regression alerts.
Define and validate LLM-as-judge methods, including calibration against human labels and bias checks, and guide teams on building representative evaluation datasets.
Govern model, prompt, and configuration changes through versioned, evidence-based evaluation before promotion.

Enterprise-Wide Delivery & Architecture

Lead technical design and delivery of Gen AI initiatives that span multiple brands, business functions, and data domains, including cross-domain agents and shared enterprise data and knowledge services.
Collaborate closely with business users to understand their needs, requirements, and workflows, and rapidly build working prototypes (using AI coding tools) that users can test and give feedback on, then iterate with them toward production-ready solutions.
Architect and develop Gen AI applications and agents using Azure AI Foundry, Azure Container Apps, Azure AI Search, and Azure Databricks.
Build full-stack solutions using Python, FastAPI, Next.js, and PostgreSQL, and design agentic workflows with tool-use patterns and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect agents to enterprise APIs, data platforms, and third-party services.
Design and optimize RAG pipelines, including hybrid search, semantic ranking, and vector indexing with Azure AI Search.
Support and extend Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft 365 Copilot solutions, and advise when a low-code, configurable, or custom-engineered approach is the right fit.
Conduct feasibility studies and proofs of concept, and turn successful ones into supported, production-grade services.

Platform, Security & LLMOps

Implement secure authentication and authorization using Microsoft Entra ID, MSAL, and service principals, and manage secrets with Azure Key Vault.
Manage APIs and microservices with Azure APIM and FastAPI.
Lead CI/CD and infrastructure automation with Azure DevOps and GitHub, including environment promotion, release management, and rollback strategy.
Apply LLMOps practices: prompt and model versioning, deprecation planning, tracing and observability, drift detection, and cost and token monitoring using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.
Implement AI safety guardrails, including content filtering, prompt injection protection, and output validation, in line with enterprise security, data classification, and responsible AI requirements.

Leadership, Governance & Collaboration

Mentor and coach engineers across teams on working effectively with AI coding agents, and raise the bar for design, code quality, testing, and evaluation practice.
Run hands-on enablement (workshops, demos, office hours) so skills and plugins are adopted, not just published.
Contribute to the AI governance framework so that solutions align with enterprise AI principles, compliance requirements, and responsible AI practices.
Communicate technical trade-offs, risks, and progress clearly to engineering peers, product owners, and senior leadership.

Qualifications

7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with 2+ years building and shipping Gen AI or LLM-based applications to production.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Advanced, daily, hands-on proficiency with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, including context engineering, instruction files, subagents, hooks, and parallel workflows, and the judgment to review and validate AI-generated code.
Demonstrated experience building skills, plugins, slash commands, subagents, or MCP servers that other engineers adopt, and distributing them through a shared repository or catalog.
Experience defining and driving engineering standards across multiple teams or products, including reusable templates, shared tooling, and agent-readable guidance.
Strong Python (required) and TypeScript or another full-stack language, with the fundamentals to design sound APIs and architectures and to direct AI agents toward maintainable results.
Hands-on testing expertise: unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end testing (for example pytest), test automation in CI, using AI to generate and maintain tests, and testing systems with non-deterministic components.
Proven experience designing and operating LLM evaluation: building golden datasets, defining metrics, using LLM-as-judge and human review, and using evals to gate releases and monitor production quality.
Deep understanding of Gen AI architectures, including RAG, tool use and function calling, MCP, and single- and multi-agent orchestration.
Proven expertise with Azure cloud services, including Azure AI Foundry, Container Apps, AI Search, APIM, Key Vault, and Monitor, plus containerization and infrastructure as code.
Experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub for CI/CD, release management, and environment promotion.
Experience with enterprise identity management (Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, service principals), secure coding practices, and responsible AI implementation, including secure use of AI coding tools with enterprise data.
Experience with observability and LLMOps: tracing, prompt and model versioning, monitoring, and cost management.
Track record of partnering directly with business users to translate requirements into working prototypes, delivering cross-functional or enterprise-scale projects with multiple stakeholders, and mentoring other engineers.
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs and standards to engineers, business partners, and senior leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
Experience with the Claude Agent SDK or similar frameworks, and running coding agents headlessly in CI/CD for review, testing, or automation.
Experience operating an internal plugin or skills marketplace, including versioning, testing, and measuring adoption.
Experience with Databricks (Unity Catalog, Genie, MCP integrations) and enterprise semantic or data layers.
Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, and Semantic Kernel.
Experience with evaluation and observability tooling for LLM applications and agents.
Experience with multi-cloud Gen AI platforms (AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI).
Experience with MCP server design and agent-to-agent interoperability patterns.
Experience with AI safety testing, such as red teaming, prompt injection testing, and adversarial evaluation.
Experience establishing or contributing to an AI governance or engineering community of practice in a large enterprise.

Title

Team

Credit Analytics
. Builds the predictive models that drive our credit and lending decisions. We turn deep knowledge of our data into models that are deployed in production, and we work closely with Risk, Finance, Product, and Engineering to improve how we underwrite, price, and manage our customers' credit.

Location:
Austin, TX

You'll build the models, take them into production, and show what they changed for the business. We're a small company, so you'll wear many hats and work with engineering to put your models into our decisioning engine. We care less about "here's the model and here's what it does" and more about the dollars and percentages it moved, the context behind it, and how clearly you explain it.

Dig into the data to understand why a model behaves the way it does, and keep digging until the answer holds up
Measure and communicate the business impact of your work in dollars and percentages

Evaluate and work with the data vendors and tools we use

8+ years of professional data scientist experience
Strong Python skills and a record of building predictive models

Business impact you can quantify, with the dollars and percentages to show it
Curiosity that goes past "here's a cool model," and the habit of asking why until you understand the context
Clear communication with both technical and non-technical audiences
Experience taking models from development to production

What Separates You

Experience in credit and lending with fintech as a plus
Experience working with third-party data vendors
Experience at a small or scaling company where you owned work end to end
Comfort moving between hands-on modeling, stakeholder partnership, and mentoring

The team will also incubate, build, and scale new GenAI tools, capabilities, and reusable frameworks that improve developer productivity and organizational effectiveness and can be broadly consumed across CCIBT.

As part of this team, you will advise, design, build, and maintain innovative AI-enabled solutions, making sound architectural and engineering decisions around scalability, performance, security, reliability, and cost. You will work closely with key stakeholders across product, development, infrastructure, operations, security, and the broader organization to turn AI opportunities into scalable solutions that deliver measurable value to our internal customers.

Lead complex technology initiatives including those that are companywide with broad impact
Act as a key participant in developing standards and companywide best practices for engineering complex and large-scale technology solutions for technology engineering disciplines

Review and analyze complex, large-scale technology solutions to meet their strategic technical and business objects
Provide influence, thought leadership and mentorship on the best practices and standards of your team
Collaborate and consult with key technical experts, senior technology team, and external industry groups to resolve complex technical issues and achieve goals
Partner and support working relationships with other teams within the Wells Fargo organization including senior leadership
Invest in the growth of your colleagues

added.description:
Senior Data Scientist

Who are we?

Versant Health is one of the nation’s leading administrators of managed vision care, serving millions of our clients’ members nationwide. We are driven by our mission to help members enjoy the wonders of sight through healthy eyes and vision.

As a Versant Health associate, you can enjoy a comprehensive Total Rewards package, which includes health and dental insurance, tuition reimbursement, 401(k) with company match, pet insurance, no-cost-to-you vision insurance for you and your qualified dependents. We are also invested in your success. There are many opportunities for advancement and development throughout all stages of your career with us.

See how you can make a difference with the support of strong leadership and a team environment.

See Everything, Be Anything™.

What are we looking for?

The Senior Data Scientist is a principal‑level individual contributor responsible for architecting, delivering, and governing enterprise‑grade advanced analytics and machine learning solutions that materially influence strategic decisions, financial performance, operational efficiency, and regulatory posture.

This role operates at the intersection of data science, data engineering, cloud analytics platforms, and business strategy, serving as a technical authority and thought leader across complex, high‑risk analytical initiatives—particularly within regulated healthcare environments.

The Senior Data Scientist is accountable not only for model development, but for explainability, stability, auditability, and long‑term operational viability of analytical solutions deployed at scale within the Microsoft data ecosystem.

Where you will have an impact

Architect, design, and deploy advanced statistical, predictive, and machine learning solutions that support enterprise‑level decision‑making across healthcare, operations, finance, and customer/member domains.
Own end‑to‑end analytical solution lifecycle, including data discovery, feature engineering, modeling, validation, performance monitoring, retraining strategy, and retirement planning.
Serve as a technical authority on model explainability, fairness, robustness, and regulatory defensibility—particularly where ground truth or forward‑looking forecasts are limited.
Design analytics solutions natively within the Microsoft cloud analytics stack, ensuring alignment to enterprise data architecture and governance standards.
Partner closely with executive stakeholders, data engineering leaders, and platform owners to translate complex business questions into high‑impact, production‑ready analytics.
Lead and influence analytics standards without direct authority.
Define best practices for: model documentation, audit artifacts, model risk management, stability analysis, reproducibility, and controlled experimentation.
Guide and review work produced by other data scientists, analysts, and vendors to ensure technical rigor and business relevance.
Present complex analytical findings to senior leadership using clear narratives, decision‑oriented visuals, and quantified trade‑offs.
Proactively identify analytical risks, data limitations, and downstream impacts of modeling decisions.
Continuously evaluate emerging tools, methodologies, and Microsoft platform capabilities to drive modernization and performance gains.

What’s necessary to do the job?

Master's degree in data science, statistics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, or related field required.
7–10+ years of progressive experience delivering advanced analytics or machine learning solutions in complex, data‑rich environments.
Required: Prior experience in healthcare analytics (payer, provider, life sciences, or regulated healthcare data domains).
Prior acutrary experience a plus.
Proven experience deploying production analytics or ML solutions supporting mission‑critical business processes.
Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit‑learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow where appropriate)
SQL (advanced T‑SQL optimization, analytical patterns)
ML explainability and governance techniques (e.g., SHAP‑style approaches, stability testing)
Deep, hands-on, production experience across sizable portion of the Microsoft analytics ecosystem, including:
Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Real-Time Analytics, Notebooks)
Azure Synapse Analytics (dedicated & serverless SQL pools)
Azure Data Factory (Fabric Data Pipelines)
Azure Data Lake Storage
Azure Machine Learning (model training, deployment, monitoring)
Power BI (semantic models, DAX optimization, executive dashboards)
Microsoft Purview (data cataloging, lineage, classification)

HIPAA & Security Requirements

All Associates must comply with the Health Insurance Portability Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA) as it pertains to disclosures of protected health information (PHI) as described in the Notice of Privacy Practices and HIPAA Privacy Policies and Procedures. As a component of job roles and responsibilities, Associates may have access to covered information, cardholder data or other confidential customer information which must be protected at all times. As a result, Associates must explicitly adhere to all data security guidelines established within the Company’s Privacy & Security Training Program.

Benefits include medical, dental, and paid vision coverage; paid time off and company holidays; retirement savings with employer contribution; employee wellness resources; and professional development opportunities. added.description:
Location: New York, Atlanta, Boston, Charlotte, Chicago, Grandview Heights, Hoboken, and Philadelphia

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

EY is the only professional services firm with a separate business unit (“FSO”) that is dedicated to the financial services marketplace. Our FSO teams have been at the forefront of every event that has reshaped and redefined the financial services industry. If you have a passion for rallying together to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, join our dynamic FSO team!

The business problems our clients are facing today are not the same problems they have faced in the past. The rapid pace of development in Artificial Intelligence and the technology that enables it has created an urgent need to innovate and adapt to the new global business paradigm. Financial institutions are looking to build smarter and more efficient ways to operate their business, create new revenue streams, and better manage risk, through new opportunities uncovered by their data. We believe that to fully unlock the potential of Artificial Intelligence, we need to look not only at its application, but also at the strategy level for how best to transform the enterprise into one that is technology and data focused and ready for the new age. Our clients’ problems are becoming increasingly complex while at the same time the need to automate and streamline is rising.

The Opportunity

Supports the delivery of solution or infrastructure development services for AI/ML initiatives, applying strong technical capability and hands-on engineering experience. Contributes to the design, development, delivery, and maintenance of AI-enabled solutions or infrastructure while aligning relevant engineering standards and project delivery expectations. Understands business and user requirements and helps translate them into sound technical designs and implementation plans. Contributes to the integration of AI/ML capabilities into broader enterprise solutions, with a focus on quality, scalability, and user impact.

Your Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, test, deploy, and support production-grade AI/ML, generative AI, and intelligent automation solutions.
Solve complex technical problems through coding, debugging, testing, troubleshooting, and structured design remediation.
Translate business and user requirements into technical designs, APIs, workflows, and supportable implementation patterns.
Build and integrate LLM, RAG, and agentic solution components into enterprise applications and platforms.
Contribute to system design across service boundaries, orchestration layers, data flows, security controls, and external integrations.
Support project delivery through disciplined execution, estimation, documentation, status communication, and risk identification.
Partner with Development, Engineering, Product, Data, Architecture, and project leadership teams to deliver high-value AI capabilities.
Improve performance, resilience, maintainability, and cost efficiency of deployed AI systems.
Participate in architecture and design reviews, providing thoughtful trade-off analysis and implementation input.
Use modern AI-assisted software engineering tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent agentic coding platforms as part of day-to-day engineering delivery.

Forward Deployed Engineering Requirements:

Work directly with client stakeholders and delivery teams to clarify business needs, navigate client constraints, and own defined components or workstreams from technical design through implementation, testing, and deployment.
Implement AI capabilities using relevant application frameworks such as Google ADK, LangChain, or LangGraph, applying the framework best suited to the use case and client environment.
Build and integrate APIs, data services, and asynchronous workflows; contribute to event-driven integrations using Apache Kafka or comparable messaging platforms.
Support deployment and troubleshooting in client cloud, on-premises, or hybrid environments. Partner with Implementation Engineers, Data Engineers, and client teams to resolve integration and data-readiness issues.
Apply version control, code review, automated testing, and CI/CD practices, and communicate progress, technical questions, blockers, and delivery risks clearly to team members and client contacts.
Bring hands-on application or service engineering experience using Python, Java, TypeScript, or a comparable language, together with working knowledge of APIs, data formats, and software testing. The experience requirement is 3+ years in software engineering, application development, systems integration, or a related technical role, including meaningful AI/ML engineering experience.
A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

AI and Engineering Skills:

Gen AI Foundational:

Ability to understand business challenges and translate them into value-add AI solutions leveraging large language models and intelligent automation
Experience designing, building, and maintaining production-grade LLM applications, including end-to-end pipelines from data ingestion through model output delivery (e.g. Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI)
Demonstrated experience building retrieval-augmented systems that ground model outputs in enterprise knowledge sources, including chunking strategies, embedding pipelines, and retrieval optimization (e.g. LlamaIndex, LangChain, Pinecone, Weaviate, Azure AI Search, pgvector etc.)
Knowledge of embedding models, vector search, and semantic retrieval patterns used to ground LLM outputs in enterprise knowledge sources (e.g. OpenAI Embeddings, Azure AI Search, pgvector etc.)
Proficiency in prompt engineering techniques including zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought, and structured output design, with the ability to systematically evaluate and iterate on prompt performance (e.g. DSPy, PromptFlow etc.)

Agentic and LLM Ops:

Experience designing and building agentic systems including multi-agent orchestration patterns, tool use, and memory design across single and multi-step workflows (e.g. LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, NVIDIA NIM etc.)
Ability to build reliable agent loops including failure handling, retries, fallbacks, and context window management across complex multi-step agentic workflows
Ability to debug, troubleshoot, and remediate production LLM and agentic systems including failure diagnosis across retrieval, orchestration, and generation layers
Experience designing and implementing LLM evaluation frameworks covering functional correctness, output quality, safety, and business-defined KPIs (e.g. RAGAS, DeepEval, ArizePhoenix etc.)

Software Engineering:

Hands-on software engineering proficiency in Python, with the ability to write clean, modular, production-quality code for LLM pipelines and agentic applications
Experience working with structured and unstructured data sets to support LLM application development, including data curation, preparation, and quality validation for model inputs
Familiarity with RESTful and event-driven API patterns including asynchronous workflows, service boundaries, and integration of enterprise data sources to expose LLM and agentic capabilities
Familiarity with containerization and orchestration concepts for packaging and deploying LLM applications in cloud environments (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, Azure Container Apps, AWS ECS etc.)
Understanding of software engineering best practices as applied to ML systems, including modular code design, testing patterns for AI pipelines, and data quality validation
Soft Skills and additional attributes for success:
Clear communicator able to explain complex AI system behavior and tradeoffs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders, including risk and compliance.
Strong ownership and accountability, taking responsibility for AI systems from design through production and issue resolution.
Comfort with ambiguity, able to operate effectively as requirements, regulations, and technologies evolve.
Collaborative and cross functional, working closely with engineering, product, risk, legal, and audit teams.
Sound judgment in regulated environments, with awareness of risk, controls, and when human oversight is required.
Bachelor’s degree preferred.
3+ years of applied engineering experience, including meaningful experience in AI/ML engineering roles.

Demonstrated experience in the following areas will be a huge plus:

Ability to build and maintain model observability pipelines including tracing of multi-step agentic reasoning chains, output degradation detection, and behavioral drift monitoring in production (e.g. LangSmith, Arize, Datadog, Azure Monitor etc.)
Familiarity with LLM fine-tuning approaches including instruction tuning and preference optimization, with an understanding of when fine-tuning is appropriate versus prompt-based solutions (e.g. LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, NeMo Framework etc.)
Familiarity with inference optimization principles — latency, throughput, and cost management — to support scalable and cost-effective LLM deployment
Familiarity with AI security considerations relevant to LLM systems, including prompt injection risks, adversarial input handling, and audit trail requirements
Familiarity with responsible AI principles including bias and fairness evaluation, human-in-the-loop design, and explainability approaches in the financial services contexts
Familiarity with data pipeline design for AI workloads including ingestion, transformation, and quality validation
Familiarity with cloud-based platforms for building, training, and deploying scalable LLM solutions (e.g. Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, Google Vertex AI etc.)
Familiarity with AI-assisted software engineering tools for accelerating development, implementation, and code review practices (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex etc.)

Ideally, you’ll also have:

Master’s degree in Business Administration (MBA) or Science (MS) preferred
Prior consulting experience

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

The salary range for this job is:
New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $134,700 to $202,200
Bay Area California offices – $140,400 to $210,700
All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $112,300 to $185,400

Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

Ability to debug, troubleshoot, and remediate production LLM and agentic systems including failure diagnosis across retrieval, orchestration, and generation layers
Experience designing and implementing LLM evaluation frameworks covering functional correctness, output quality, safety, and business-defined KPIs (e.g. RAGAS, DeepEval, ArizePhoenix etc.)

Hands-on software engineering proficiency in Python, with the ability to write clean, modular, production-quality code for LLM pipelines and agentic applications
Experience working with structured and unstructured data sets to support LLM application development, including data curation, preparation, and quality validation for model inputs
Familiarity with RESTful and event-driven API patterns including asynchronous workflows, service boundaries, and integration of enterprise data sources to expose LLM and agentic capabilities
Familiarity with containerization and orchestration concepts for packaging and deploying LLM applications in cloud environments (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, Azure Container Apps, AWS ECS etc.)
Understanding of software engineering best practices as applied to ML systems, including modular code design, testing patterns for AI pipelines, and data quality validation
Soft Skills and additional attributes for success:
Clear communicator able to explain complex AI system behavior and tradeoffs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders, including risk and compliance.
Strong ownership and accountability, taking responsibility for AI systems from design through production and issue resolution.
Comfort with ambiguity, able to operate effectively as requirements, regulations, and technologies evolve.
Collaborative and cross functional, working closely with engineering, product, risk, legal, and audit teams.
Sound judgment in regulated environments, with awareness of risk, controls, and when human oversight is required.
Bachelor’s degree preferred.
3+ years of applied engineering experience, including meaningful experience in AI/ML engineering roles.

Demonstrated experience in the following areas will be a huge plus:

Ability to build and maintain model observability pipelines including tracing of multi-step agentic reasoning chains, output degradation detection, and behavioral drift monitoring in production (e.g. LangSmith, Arize, Datadog, Azure Monitor etc.)

added.description:
Working at the Naval Nuclear Laboratory we foster pride in belonging to an organization whose culture is made up of these core values: Trust, Empowerment, and Collaboration. Our company promotes a positive culture while ensuring the safety and reliability of our nation's naval nuclear reactors, and training the Sailors who operate those reactors in the U.S. Navy's submarines and aircraft carrier Fleets. Looking for a lifetime career? Apply today!

Job Description

Are you an experienced data scientist interested in discovering new ways to improve complex engineering and manufacturing work? The Data Systems unit in Naval Nuclear Laboratory's Core Manufacturing department is seeking a Senior Data Scientist to establish a cross-cutting data science capability and deliver new value across the department through advanced analytics and machine learning.

As a department-wide data science resource, you will collaborate with engineers, statisticians, other data scientists, data engineers, software developers, and stakeholders across Core Manufacturing to understand diverse technical and operational needs and identify high-value analytical opportunities. You will independently evaluate opportunities and work with department leadership, technical organizations, and stakeholders to define and prioritize a portfolio of cross-cutting data science initiatives based on mission impact, feasibility, and organizational value. You will translate technical and operational challenges into data-driven solutions that improve manufacturing processes, engineering workflows, and decision-making across Core Manufacturing and the core vendor.

As Core Manufacturing's data infrastructure continues to mature, you will work closely with data engineers and software developers to leverage and help expand existing data capabilities. Where necessary, you will work hands-on with data from fragmented or evolving sources, performing the extraction, preparation, integration, and quality checks needed to develop early analytical solutions. Your understanding of high-value analytical opportunities will also help the team prioritize future data sources, pipelines, and infrastructure improvements.

This role offers the opportunity to shape how data science is applied across a broad range of Core Manufacturing challenges while collaborating with specialists in individual technical domains. You will work across the analytical lifecycle-from identifying and prioritizing opportunities through data preparation, modeling, validation, implementation, and adoption-while helping the department use its growing data resources to make better decisions.

Required Combination Of Knowledge And Skill

Bachelors degree from an accredited college or university in a related engineering or science field and a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience; or Masters degree from an accredited college or university in a related engineering or science field and a minimum of 4 years of relevant experience; or Doctorate degree from an accredited college or university in a related engineering or science field and a minimum of 1 year of relevant experience.

Preferred Skills

Experience applying data science, statistical analysis, machine learning, optimization, or similar methods to engineering, manufacturing, scientific, or operational problems.
Proficiency with Python, R, SQL, or comparable data-analysis tools and programming languages, including experience acquiring, cleaning, integrating, and analyzing data from multiple sources.
Ability to work hands-on with data from fragmented or evolving sources and develop practical early solutions while shared data infrastructure continues to mature.
Experience validating analytical methods, characterizing uncertainty and limitations, and translating models or analyses into interpretable, sustainable decision-support tools or repeatable workflows.
Ability to independently learn unfamiliar technical domains and identify valuable analytical opportunities from ambiguous or cross-cutting needs.
Ability to evaluate and prioritize potential work based on mission impact, organizational value, feasibility, and required effort.
Ability to communicate technical findings, limitations, completed work, and potential data science applications clearly to non-data-science audiences and collaborate effectively with domain experts and analytical professionals across a variety of stakeholder groups.
Commitment to transparent methods, shared tools, clear documentation, and sustainable solutions that can be understood and maintained by others.

added.title: Lead AI Engineer
added.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Lead AI Engineer

Overview

Mastercard is seeking a Lead AI Engineer to join a small, focused AI technology team led by one of Mastercard's Distinguished Engineers. The team will initially focus on delivering agentic technologies such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at scale and the use of open weight AI models. The team works in partnership with key technology stakeholders across the organization.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will design and build the platform capabilities that let Mastercard adopt MCP and open weight models safely and at scale, working alongside more senior engineers who set the broader technical direction. We are looking for someone with strong knowledge of modern AI technology, solid software engineering and MLOps skills, good cloud platform experience, familiarity with identity technologies such as OAuth and a practical grasp of model evaluation.

In this role, you will help build the platform patterns through which Mastercard teams expose tools and data to agents over MCP, and through which the enterprise services, evaluates, and governs open weight models. You will contribute to the key technical decisions — gateway and connectivity patterns, identity and access controls, model-serving infrastructure, and evaluation — and turn them into working, well-engineered, production-grade services. You will work across the MCP estate and the OW model working group, partnering closely with the team's senior engineers and with central technology, security, and governance stakeholders.

About The Role

Contribute to the design and build of the components of Mastercard's enterprise MCP deployment, such as the security gateway, the MCP registry that governs what exists and who owns it, and reference server implementations that teams build from. Take these from design through to running production services.
Implement the identity, authentication, and authorization patterns for MCP across the estate, working with the team's senior engineers and central security and identity teams so that agents, tools, and data are accessed securely and are auditable end to end.
Help set and apply the standard for internal and external MCP servers — how tools and data are exposed, discovered and versioned, and the inspection, data-protection, rate-limiting, and kill-switch controls the gateway must enforce.
Build and operate open weight model serving — stand up and scale self-hosted inference, package models for deployment, and help enable switching workloads across models and providers for cost, flexibility, and resilience.
Build the evaluation and testing tooling that benchmarks candidate open weight models for quality, cost, latency, and safety, and produces the reproducible evidence that governance and security reviews need.
Apply the MLOps practices that keep the platform reliable — CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, observability, and model and service monitoring — so that what the team builds is maintainable and operable in production.
Partner with central security, privacy, legal and AI governance teams, and with the MCP SIG and OW working group, implementing their requirements correctly for the platform's architecture.
Keep current with a rapidly evolving landscape, such as new MCP developments, frontier open weight releases, and related agentic protocols, and help the team decide what to adopt, prototype, or wait on.

All About You

Strong knowledge of modern AI technology: LLMs and foundation models, agents, and the tooling and protocols (such as MCP) that connect them to enterprise systems.
Good software engineering skills: you write production-quality, well-tested code and build services others can depend on, not one-off scripts or prototypes.
Solid MLOps experience: CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, containers, observability, and monitoring for models and services in production.
Good cloud platform knowledge (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP valuable). Familiarity with a modern data/AI platform such as Databricks a bonus.
Practical experience with model evaluation, including building benchmarks and tests that measure quality, cost, latency and safety, and producing reproducible results others can rely on.
Hands-on experience serving or operating open weight models, self-hosting, and scaling inference, and ideally some fine-tuning or adaptation to proprietary data and workflows.
Working knowledge of API security, identity, and access control, enough to implement MCP authentication and authorization correctly and partner effectively with security teams.
Awareness of the governance context that shapes enterprise AI, such as model provenance and licensing, data sovereignty, and financial-services regulation.
A clear communicator and collaborator who works well with senior engineers, hands-on peers, and specialist governance and security partner teams.
Intense curiosity about technology in general, and AI in particular, and who can demonstrate their learning agility outside the bounds of a specific function.
Lastly, a self-starter: once you have a clear guidance and direction, you don’t need to be hand-held to get to a solution or deliverable.

#AI1

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. added.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer (AI/Platform)- League of Legends
added.description:
ML engineers at Riot own the full lifecycle of machine learning in production — from problem framing through model design, deployment, and operation — building systems that serve players at global scale. They work across disciplines with engineers, data scientists, designers, and product teams to turn ML capabilities into player-facing experiences and tools for making great games.

The Role

As a Principal AI/ML Platform Engineer for League of Legends
, you will set ML platform and integration strategy that enables League teams to build, launch, and operate player and developer facing ML experiences. You will build the systems, tooling, and operational standards that enable teams to deploy and operate ML at global scale. Your technical direction will influence product strategy and your work will directly shape how League of Legends evolves player-facing experiences. Your work will span year-plus efforts on League, mentoring and coaching across disciplines. You will report to the Senior ML Engineering Manager within the League of Legends game team. This role is based out of our Los Angeles area headquarters.

Responsibilities

Lead AI/ML workflow and MLOps for League of Legends; build automation standards including auto-remediation and self-healing pipelines; drive implementation.
Create AI/ML serving architecture that scales to production load for Riot’s player base; design systems requiring minimal operational intervention; drive implementation of proven serving architectures.
Build ML feature platforms to scale feature development and processing; solve scale, latency, or reliability constraints in ML data pipelines.
Lead AI/ML developer experience that accelerates development; remove workflow bottlenecks and enable new capabilities.
Lead AI/ML governance in partnership with compliance experts to ensure regulatory adherence; drive implementation of proven frameworks.
Ensure AI/ML platform security in partnership with security teams; drive implementation of proven privacy, security, and cryptography techniques for AI/ML.
Create AI/ML pipeline development and deployment standards, coordinating with data engineering on shared MLOps capabilities.
Craft AI/ML service development and API standards across product integrations.
Drive operational excellence and cost optimization for AI/ML systems across the organization.
Run incident management and set response standards for AI/ML systems across production services.
Build observability and monitoring standards for AI/ML systems across services.
Create tooling strategy and evaluation for AI/ML platforms across the organization.
Drive mentorship of senior engineers across multiple products or problem areas; coach developers across disciplines.
Drive recruiting standards across multiple products or problem areas; contribute to interview kits and TA efforts.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 5+ years building production ML platforms, systems, or MLOps capabilities.
Evidence that platforms or systems you’ve led have become load-bearing for multiple teams or products — adopted, depended on, and evolved beyond the original scope.
Deep operational intuition for ML systems at scale: you’ve lived through the failure modes (training-serving skew, silent degradation, cost spirals) and built the systems to prevent them.
Background in cloud-native orchestration and large-scale system design (Kubernetes, GPU scheduling, container orchestration) applied at global scale.
History of improving developer experience for ML practitioners in ways that measurably changed how fast or reliably they shipped.
Track record mentoring senior and staff-level engineers; evidence of elevating platform engineering judgment across an organization.
Experience building ML platforms that serve multiple products or game titles simultaneously is a plus.
Track record solving novel scale, latency, or reliability constraints in ML data pipelines is a plus.
Background in ML governance, security, privacy-preserving techniques, or compliance at organizational scale is a plus.
Passion for player experience, games, or creative technology.

For this role, you will find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

Our Perks

Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k with company match. Check out our benefits pages
for more information.

At Riot Games, we put players first. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

It’s our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and members of Riot Games, Inc. Riot Games makes reasonable accommodations for handicapped and disabled Rioters and does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, handicap, veteran status, marital status, criminal history, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law. We consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including the California Fair Chance Act, the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the Washington Fair Chance Act.

Duties

Per the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the following core duties may create a basis for disqualifying candidates with relevant criminal histories:

Safeguarding confidential and sensitive Company data
Communication with others, including Rioters and third parties such as vendors, and/or players, including minors
Accessing Company assets, secure digital systems, and networks
Ensuring a safe interactive environment for players and other Rioters

These duties are directly related to essential operations, safety, trust, and compliance obligations within our organization. Please note that job duties may evolve based on business needs and additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to maintain operational efficiency and security.
